Every call that routes there is refused before the request is sent, and the tools stop offering it as an example. Unset leaves it available. environment_variables.description: An OpenAI-compatible /v1/embeddings endpoint you run. Set it and embeddings are computed on this machine rather than by Noetive: a publish carries the vector alongside its text, and a query's anchor phrases are replaced by vectors so they are never sent. The endpoint must answer to the same model name as NOETIVE_MODEL and return NOETIVE_DIMENSIONS values. Plain http is accepted only for a loopback address. environment_variables.description: Hard daily USD cap enforced locally. Server refuses calls after the cap until UTC midnight. Unlimited if unset. Honoured by `ask`, `code`, and per-iteration by `ask_agentic`.

environment_variables.description: Model alias (`latest-pro-thinking`, `latest-pro`, `latest-flash`, `latest-lite`, `latest-vision`) or literal model ID, read by ask, ask_agentic and code. environment_variables.description: `implicit` (default since v1.14.0: the workspace text is sent inline, Gemini's automatic prefix cache decides any discount) or `explicit` (Files API upload + Context Cache with Google's cached-input price). Per-call `cachingMode` wins.

environment_variables.description: Recommended path: skip this UI and run `q402_doctor` after install - it stores secrets in ~/.q402/mcp.env, which the server auto-loads. Fill this field directly ONLY if your MCP client manages secrets for you. Value is a Free Trial API key from https://q402.quackai.ai/event - BNB Chain (permanent) + Base (permanent) + Mantle limited-time (2026-08-21~08-28 UTC+9), 500 sponsored TXs, gas covered by Q402. Avalanche trial has ended. BNB and Base payments auto-route to this key when set (same rule for q402_pay and q402_batch_pay up to 5 recipients).
environment_variables.name: Q402_TRIAL_API_KEY

environment_variables.description: Recommended path: skip this UI and run `q402_doctor` after install - it stores secrets in ~/.q402/mcp.env, which the server auto-loads. Fill this field directly ONLY if your MCP client manages secrets for you. Value is a Paid Multichain API key from https://q402.quackai.ai/payment - full 12-chain support with per-chain Gas Tank. Auto-routed for non-BNB payments and whenever keyScope='multichain' is chosen.
environment_variables.name: Q402_MULTICHAIN_API_KEY

environment_variables.description: Mode A - real EOA signing. Hex-encoded EVM private key (0x + 64 hex chars) of YOUR MetaMask wallet, used to sign payment authorizations LOCALLY on your machine. After your first payment that wallet shows as 'Smart account' in MetaMask (EIP-7702 delegation, reversible via q402_clear_delegation). Use a fresh wallet, not your main one. Skip this and pick Mode B (Q402_AGENTIC_PRIVATE_KEY) or Mode C (server-managed Agent Wallet) if you'd rather keep your MetaMask untouched. Recommended path: run q402_doctor after install - it stores secrets in ~/.q402/mcp.env, which the server auto-loads.
environment_variables.name: Q402_PRIVATE_KEY

environment_variables.description: Mode B - local Agent Wallet signing. Hex-encoded EVM private key (0x + 64 hex chars) exported from your Agent Wallet at https://q402.quackai.ai/dashboard -> Agent tab -> Export. Signs LOCALLY just like Mode A, but the signer is your dedicated Agent Wallet - your MetaMask EOA is never touched. Pick this for AI-agent automation when you want a dedicated purse with per-tx + daily caps you set on the dashboard.
environment_variables.name: Q402_AGENTIC_PRIVATE_KEY

environment_variables.description: Live-mode switch. 0 = sandbox (test mode, no funds move - every q402_pay returns a fake hash). 1 = real on-chain payments. Default 1 since v0.5.11: safe because mode only flips to live when a live API key (q402_live_*) is set AND one of (a) a valid 32-byte private key for local signing modes, OR (b) walletMode="agentic-server" with Q402_MULTICHAIN_API_KEY for the server-managed Agent Wallet path. Without either combination, the server stays in sandbox regardless of this flag.
environment_variables.name: Q402_ENABLE_REAL_PAYMENTS

environment_variables.description: Per-call USD-equivalent cap for USDC/USDT/RLUSD. Any such q402_pay request with amount above this is rejected before signing. Q (QuackAI) is exempt by design (your own token; recipient allowlist + confirmation still apply). Lower this for a tighter agent blast-radius; raise for treasury-grade transfers.
environment_variables.name: Q402_MAX_AMOUNT_PER_CALL

environment_variables.description: Optional comma-separated lowercase EVM addresses. When set, q402_pay rejects any recipient not on this allowlist.
environment_variables.name: Q402_ALLOWED_RECIPIENTS

environment_variables.description: Override for the Q402 relay endpoint. Defaults to https://q402.quackai.ai/api. Set explicitly when running against a self-hosted Q402 deployment or a non-canonical environment.
environment_variables.name: Q402_RELAY_BASE_URL

environment_variables.description: Server-managed Agent Wallet picker (walletMode='agentic-server' only). Lowercased agent wallet address (the hex 0x... shown on the Agent tab of your dashboard) selecting which of your Agent Wallets to spend from when you hold more than one (max 10 per owner). Omit to use the default wallet. Ignored for the local-signing modes that carry their own private key.
environment_variables.name: Q402_AGENT_WALLET_ADDRESS

environment_variables.description: DEPRECATED legacy single-key env from pre-v0.5.0 installs. The server still reads it as a silent fallback so existing setups keep working, but new users should pick a scoped variant instead. Q402_TRIAL_API_KEY (Free Trial, BNB Chain + Base) and Q402_MULTICHAIN_API_KEY (full 12-chain surface) are designed to coexist - BNB and Base payments auto-route to the trial key, other chains use multichain. Only set Q402_API_KEY if you are migrating an existing pre-v0.5.0 install; do NOT set it alongside the scoped variants on a fresh install.
environment_variables.name: Q402_API_KEY

environment_variables.description: DEPRECATED soft-migration alias for Q402_AGENT_WALLET_ADDRESS (one release of overlap from v0.6.0). The server still accepts it but logs a deprecation notice. New installs should set Q402_AGENT_WALLET_ADDRESS directly.
environment_variables.name: Q402_WALLET_ID

environment_variables.description: Optional Base Builder Code for onchain attribution (ERC-8021 / Base Builder Codes). When set, every q402_x402_fetch payment includes your code as the client/intermediary in the x402 payment extension so payments are attributed onchain. Format: 1-32 lowercase letters, numbers, or underscores. Leave unset to disable attribution.
environment_variables.name: Q402_BUILDER_CODE

environment_variables.description: Override Ollama's num_ctx for embed requests. Leave UNSET to let obsidian-brain auto-detect via `/api/show`'s `context_length` (e.g. nomic-embed-text=2048, bge-m3=8192, qwen3-embedding:0.6b=32 768). Setting this manually imposes a hard cap and may silently truncate longer inputs — see https://github.com/ollama/ollama/issues/14259. Ollama's own default is 2048 which truncates for any model trained on a larger context. See also https://github.com/ollama/ollama/issues/7008. Fallback when both env is unset AND /api/show is unreachable: 8192.
environment_variables.name: OLLAMA_NUM_CTX

environment_variables.description: Auto-pull the configured Ollama model when /api/show returns 404 (model not present). Default ON — choosing an Ollama-backed preset is implicit consent to download its model. Streams /api/pull progress to stderr. Set to '0' to disable auto-pull entirely (master kill-switch) and fall back to the actionable error path (`HTTP 404 — try: ollama pull <model>`).

environment_variables.description: Opt-in to auto-pull for BYOM (custom EMBEDDING_MODEL) Ollama models OUTSIDE Ollama's official `library/` namespace. Default OFF — third-party models (e.g. `user/custom-fork`, `myregistry.com/team/model`) require this env var to be set to `1` before they will auto-pull, to prevent silent downloads of arbitrary user-named artifacts. Preset-known models (via EMBEDDING_PRESET) and bare model ids in the official library (e.g. `qwen3-embedding:0.6b`, `library/llama3:8b`) continue to auto-pull by default per the existing OBSIDIAN_BRAIN_OLLAMA_AUTO_PULL behavior.

environment_variables.description: Set to '1' to disable the live chokidar file watcher. Useful on SMB/NFS vaults where FSEvents/inotify don't fire reliably — fall back to running `obsidian-brain index` on a schedule (launchd/systemd).

package_arguments.description: Absolute path to the single folder to serve, read-only. Wins over WYRD_GRANT. Any path inside it can be requested, hidden entries included, such as .env and .git/config, apart from a handful of name spellings refused as input: a drive-letter-and-colon prefix such as C:notes on every host, and on Windows a colon inside a component (which names a data stream rather than a file) or a reserved device name such as NUL.md. What comes back is narrower than what can be requested: a directory is refused, and so are bytes that are not valid UTF-8. That limits what is readable, not what is reachable; grant a subfolder containing only what you mean to share.

environment_variables.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_TOOLS_DENY

environment_variables.description: Log rendering. rich is one colour event key=value line per record, for a terminal; json is one JSON object per record, for a collector. Unset picks rich when stderr is a terminal and json everywhere else, so a container or journald gets JSON with no configuration.
environment_variables.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_LOG_FORMAT

environment_variables.description: OpenAI API key for the openai embedding provider, and the fallback key for the summarize tool when MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_SUMMARIZE_OPENAI_API_KEY is unset. Bare (not MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_-prefixed), matching the OpenAI ecosystem convention.
environment_variables.name: OPENAI_API_KEY

environment_variables.description: Voyage AI API key for the voyage embedding provider. Bare (not MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_-prefixed), matching the OPENAI_API_KEY / OLLAMA_HOST convention. Setting it never auto-selects the provider; choose it explicitly with MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_EMBEDDING_PROVIDER=voyage.
environment_variables.name: VOYAGE_API_KEY

environment_variables.description: Bare fallback for MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_OPENAI_BASE_URL (embeddings). For the summarize tool it only routes traffic when an API key already enables the feature; it never enables summarize by itself.
environment_variables.name: OPENAI_BASE_URL

environment_variables.description: Bare fallback for MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_OPENAI_EMBEDDING_MODEL.
environment_variables.name: OPENAI_EMBEDDING_MODEL

environment_variables.description: Maximum seconds an index-backed tool or resource waits for the FTS index to become queryable during a cold-start background build before raising IndexUnavailableError(reason="timeout"). Increase for large vaults.
environment_variables.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_BUILD_TIMEOUT_S

environment_variables.description: Maximum seconds an index-querying read tool waits for the IndexWriter to drain when called with wait_for_pending_writes=true. On timeout the tool answers from the current index and reports index_stale=true in the response _meta.
environment_variables.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_DRAIN_TIMEOUT_S

environment_variables.description: Path to the markdown vault directory. When it does not exist, or the server cannot access it, the server starts but every tool fails with a message saying which until it is fixed (managed git mode clones into it). Symbolic links inside the vault are followed on Python 3.13+.
environment_variables.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_SOURCE_DIR

environment_variables.description: Set to true to hide the write tools (write, edit, append, delete, rename, move_folder, fetch, git_sync, the okf_* tools, create_upload_link) and serve a search-only vault.
environment_variables.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_READ_ONLY

environment_variables.description: Refuse a write that would overwrite an existing file when no if_match etag is supplied. Deliberate replacement still works: read the file first, then pass if_match. Unaffected: edit, append, delete, rename. Set to false to allow blind overwrites.
environment_variables.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_WRITE_PROTECT_EXISTING

environment_variables.description: Set to true to have write, edit and append list, under unresolved_links, the target of each link the call added that get_broken_links reports. Links the note already held are left out. Off by default, leaving those responses unchanged.
environment_variables.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_REPORT_UNRESOLVED_LINKS

environment_variables.description: Hide the MCP Apps UI tools (browse_vault, show_context) from the tool listing for clients that do not render MCP Apps panels.
environment_variables.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_DISABLE_APPS_UI

environment_variables.description: Path to the SQLite FTS5 index file; unset keeps the index in memory. Set it for persistence across restarts.
environment_variables.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_INDEX_PATH

environment_variables.description: Path to the change-tracking state file. Defaults to INDEX_PATH plus .state.json (index.db.state.json beside index.db); without INDEX_PATH the state is kept in memory. Never written into the vault by default.
environment_variables.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_STATE_PATH

environment_variables.description: Base path for the embeddings files. Defaults beside INDEX_PATH (index-db-embeddings.npy and .json beside index.db); without INDEX_PATH the vectors are kept in memory and rebuilt at each start. Setting it also lets the provider be auto-detected.
environment_variables.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_EMBEDDINGS_PATH

environment_variables.description: Comma-separated frontmatter fields promoted to the tag index for structured filtering. Changing it cold-rebuilds the index once on next startup; SEARCHABLE_FIELDS inherits this value when unset.
environment_variables.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_INDEXED_FIELDS

environment_variables.description: Comma-separated frontmatter fields required on every document; documents missing any are excluded from the index.
environment_variables.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_REQUIRED_FIELDS

environment_variables.description: Comma-separated glob patterns excluded from scanning, e.g. .obsidian/**,.trash/**.
environment_variables.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_EXCLUDE

environment_variables.description: Frontmatter field used as the document title (falls back to title, the first H1, then the filename). Changing it cold-rebuilds the index once on next startup.
environment_variables.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_TITLE_FIELD

environment_variables.description: Comma-separated frontmatter fields whose text values become keyword-searchable and enrich first-chunk embeddings. Inherits INDEXED_FIELDS when unset; the sentinel none means filterable but not searchable. Changing it cold-rebuilds the index and re-embeds once on next startup.
environment_variables.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_SEARCHABLE_FIELDS

environment_variables.description: Relative folder where note templates live (used by the create_from_template prompt).
environment_variables.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_TEMPLATES_FOLDER

environment_variables.description: Directory of .md prompt files that extend or override built-in prompts; a relative path is resolved against SOURCE_DIR.
environment_variables.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_PROMPTS_FOLDER

environment_variables.description: Filename of the per-folder conventions files surfaced to clients at write time (bare .md filename without glob characters). Set to none to disable folder conventions.
environment_variables.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_CONVENTIONS_FILE

environment_variables.description: OKF (Open Knowledge Format) read semantics. With auto (the default), read annotations switch on when the vault declares an OKF version in its root index.md. Use off to disable OKF semantics entirely, or on to force them for an undeclared vault. Annotations are read-only; write behavior is never affected.
environment_variables.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_OKF_MODE

environment_variables.description: OKF (Open Knowledge Format) enforced write layer. When true on an OKF-active vault, the server stamps generated provenance on each write and clears any verified attestation when a note's content changes. It also keeps each written folder's log.md and index.md current, and exposes the okf_verify tool. Requires OKF_MODE to be auto or on (a true value with OKF_MODE=off is a config error). Off by default.
environment_variables.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_OKF_WRITE

environment_variables.description: How the okf_verify tool attributes a human review. This applies only when OKF_WRITE is on, which gates the tool. With elicit (the default), okf_verify asks the human to confirm the review through an MCP elicitation, then records the attestation only on an affirmative reply. It fails closed when the client cannot elicit or the human declines, so a model holding the human's token cannot self-attest. Set trust-auth instead to attribute to a token's sub claim with no confirmation; it rejects static bearer credentials and other client-ID-only identities. This is safe only when the sole caller is a human-driven UI. Set off to hide the tool, leaving attestation to external tooling. A non-default value with OKF_WRITE off is a config error.
environment_variables.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_OKF_VERIFY

environment_variables.description: Comma-separated allowed attachment extensions (e.g. pdf,png,jpg); case and a leading dot are ignored, so PDF and .pdf name the same type. Use * to allow every non-markdown file. Unset selects the built-in allowlist. A link whose target has a listed extension is not part of the link graph; changing the list rebuilds the index once.
environment_variables.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_ATTACHMENT_EXTENSIONS

environment_variables.description: Maximum attachment size in MB returned by read / accepted by write; 0 disables the limit.
environment_variables.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_MAX_ATTACHMENT_SIZE_MB

environment_variables.description: Maximum bytes returned by a full-document read of a note; use `read(path, section=…)` for partial reads. 0 disables the limit.
environment_variables.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_MAX_NOTE_READ_BYTES

environment_variables.description: Mode used when a search call omits 'mode': auto, keyword, semantic, or hybrid. The default 'auto' picks hybrid when embeddings are configured and keyword when they are not. Pin 'keyword' to keep unqualified searches off the embedding provider (each hybrid or semantic search embeds the query, which costs an API call on a metered provider). A configured semantic/hybrid default also degrades to keyword without embeddings, so no setting can make a vault unsearchable; an explicit mode= argument is never downgraded.
environment_variables.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_DEFAULT_SEARCH_MODE

environment_variables.description: Maximum chunks returned per document in search results.
environment_variables.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_CHUNKS_PER_FILE

environment_variables.description: Width of the snippet window (words) in search results; 0 returns full chunk content.
environment_variables.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_SNIPPET_WORDS

environment_variables.description: Down-weights longer chunks in ranking: score / (1 + alpha * log(chunk_count)).
environment_variables.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_LENGTH_DOWNWEIGHT_ALPHA

environment_variables.description: Word cap per chunk; the adaptive chunker splits at deeper heading levels, then paragraph/word boundaries, to respect it. Match it to the embedding model's context. A reindex applies a new value.
environment_variables.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_MAX_CHUNK_WORDS

environment_variables.description: Character cap enforced alongside MAX_CHUNK_WORDS to bound token-dense chunks. Unset derives min(1500, model context * 2.8). Set a positive value for an exact cap, or -1 to scale with the model's full context (can exhaust memory on long-context models). A reindex applies a new value.
environment_variables.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_MAX_CHUNK_CHARS

environment_variables.description: Words of overlap between adjacent budget-split fragments of the same heading section (0 disables). A reindex applies a new value.
environment_variables.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_CHUNK_OVERLAP_WORDS

environment_variables.description: Folder-prefix score multipliers (`prefix:weight` pairs, comma-separated, weights > 0) applied to all search modes; the deepest matching prefix wins (sessions:0.5 demotes sessions/**).
environment_variables.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_FOLDER_WEIGHTS

environment_variables.description: Per-column BM25 weights (`column:weight` pairs, comma-separated, weights >= 0) for keyword ranking. Columns: path, title, folder, heading, content, summary.
environment_variables.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_FTS_WEIGHTS

environment_variables.description: Embedding provider: openai, voyage, ollama, or fastembed; setting it turns on search by meaning. Unset auto-detects from the environment (never voyage), but only when EMBEDDINGS_PATH is set. Any OpenAI-compatible endpoint works with openai plus OPENAI_BASE_URL; see the embeddings guide.
environment_variables.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_EMBEDDING_PROVIDER

environment_variables.description: Ollama embedding model name.
environment_variables.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_OLLAMA_MODEL

environment_variables.description: Force Ollama to embed on CPU only.
environment_variables.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_OLLAMA_CPU_ONLY

environment_variables.description: Voyage AI embedding model name.
environment_variables.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_VOYAGE_MODEL

environment_variables.description: OpenAI-compatible API base URL for embeddings; the bare OPENAI_BASE_URL is honoured as a fallback.
environment_variables.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_OPENAI_BASE_URL

environment_variables.description: OpenAI-compatible embedding model name; the bare OPENAI_EMBEDDING_MODEL is honoured as a fallback.
environment_variables.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_OPENAI_EMBEDDING_MODEL

environment_variables.description: FastEmbed model name.
environment_variables.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_FASTEMBED_MODEL

environment_variables.description: FastEmbed model cache directory (in Docker, stored under /data/state/fastembed).
environment_variables.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_FASTEMBED_CACHE_DIR

environment_variables.description: Enrich embedding input with the note title, chunk heading, and (first chunk) searchable-field values. Flipping it re-embeds the whole vault once on next startup.
environment_variables.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_EMBED_CONTEXT

environment_variables.description: Per-request wall-clock budget in seconds for a single embedding HTTP call (OpenAI/Ollama). The local FastEmbed backend runs in-process with no network call and ignores this. CPU-only or large-model workloads may need 60-120 s; raise this if batches time out.
environment_variables.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_EMBED_TIMEOUT_S

environment_variables.description: Number of chunks sent per embedding request. Smaller batches shorten each request (useful under a tight timeout on slow models) at the cost of more round-trips.
environment_variables.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_EMBEDDING_BATCH_SIZE

environment_variables.description: Token/password for HTTPS git auth; remotes must be HTTPS when set.
environment_variables.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_GIT_TOKEN

environment_variables.description: HTTPS remote URL for managed git mode: the server clones into an empty SOURCE_DIR on startup (or validates an existing origin) and enables the pull loop, auto-commit, and deferred push.
environment_variables.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_GIT_REPO_URL

environment_variables.description: Username for HTTPS git auth prompts (x-access-token for GitHub, oauth2 for GitLab, the account name for Bitbucket).
environment_variables.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_GIT_USERNAME

environment_variables.description: Seconds between git fetch + fast-forward update attempts; 0 disables periodic pull.
environment_variables.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_GIT_PULL_INTERVAL_S

environment_variables.description: Seconds of write-idle time before pushing; 0 pushes only on shutdown.
environment_variables.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_GIT_PUSH_DELAY_S

environment_variables.description: Git committer name for auto-commits, and the author name too unless an OIDC claim supplies one; set this in Docker where git config user.name is empty.
environment_variables.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_GIT_COMMIT_NAME

environment_variables.description: Git committer email for auto-commits, and the author email too unless an OIDC claim supplies one.
environment_variables.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_GIT_COMMIT_EMAIL

environment_variables.description: OIDC claim key used as the commit author name (e.g. name) when an OIDC token is present; the committer stays GIT_COMMIT_NAME. The claim is resolved when the tool call arrives and carried to the background commit, so it applies on every write. A configured claim the token does not carry is reported once at WARNING and the static identity is used.
environment_variables.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_GIT_COMMIT_NAME_CLAIM

environment_variables.description: OIDC claim key used as the commit author email (e.g. email) when an OIDC token is present; the committer stays GIT_COMMIT_EMAIL. Resolved and carried the same way as the name claim.
environment_variables.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_GIT_COMMIT_EMAIL_CLAIM

environment_variables.description: Run git lfs pull on startup to fetch LFS-tracked attachments; set to false for repos without LFS.
environment_variables.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_GIT_LFS

environment_variables.description: Watch the vault for external filesystem changes; auto-disabled when git pull is active or a webhook can deliver (HTTP/SSE transports only). Requires the file-watcher extra.
environment_variables.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_FILE_WATCHER

environment_variables.description: Seconds of quiet after the last filesystem event before reindexing.
environment_variables.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_FILE_WATCHER_DEBOUNCE_S

environment_variables.description: Keep the non-recursive watch on the vault root; set false to register zero source-dir-rooted FSEvents streams (avoids repeated macOS access prompts on a home-rooted vault) at the cost of root-level files relying on scans.
environment_variables.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_FILE_WATCHER_ROOT_FLOOR

environment_variables.description: Reconcile offline changes at startup by reindexing once the initial build completes. Set false on a large vault to start without paying a full filesystem scan per server start; changes made while no server was running are then invisible until a reindex runs (the reindex tool, or 'markdown-vault-mcp reindex'). Note that `index_stale` reports writer idleness, not agreement with disk, so it reads false while the index may still differ from the vault.
environment_variables.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_BOOT_REINDEX

environment_variables.description: Shared secret for the GitHub push-event webhook; when set, mounts POST /github-webhook on HTTP/SSE transports to trigger an immediate pull + reindex on push events.
environment_variables.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_GITHUB_WEBHOOK_SECRET

environment_variables.description: Signing token for the GitLab push-event webhook (GitLab 19.0+); when set, mounts POST /gitlab-webhook on HTTP/SSE transports to trigger an immediate pull + reindex on push events. GitLab generates this value; copy the `whsec_` token it shows under Generate signing token rather than inventing one. Deliveries are authenticated by HMAC-SHA256 over the webhook id, timestamp and body, and a delivery older than 5 minutes is rejected.
environment_variables.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_GITLAB_WEBHOOK_SIGNING_TOKEN

environment_variables.description: Secret token for the GitLab push-event webhook, GitLab's plain-text form and the only one below 19.0; also mounts POST /gitlab-webhook.
